fiches.marche_vise: adult patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy or who are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy
fiches.extrait: On August 26, 2026, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved RASONQUE™ (daraxonrasib) for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy or who are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy (the “FDA Approval”).
RASolute 303 (NCT07491445) — Phase 3, 1L PDAC métastatique, daraxonrasib en monothérapie ou en combinaison avec gemcitabine + nab-paclitaxel vs SOC, 900 patients, recrutement actif depuis avril 2026
RASolute 304 (NCT07252232) — Phase 3, PDAC réséqué (setting adjuvant), 500 patients, ouvert depuis décembre 2025
RASolve 301 (NCT06881784) — Phase 3, NSCLC RAS mutant pré-traité, daraxonrasib vs docétaxel, 590 patients, recrutement actif.
RASolute 305 (NCT07621718) — Phase 3, zoldonrasib (RMC-9805) en 1L PDAC métastatique KRAS G12D, 670 patients, ouvert mai 2026
RASolve 308 (NCT07777822) — Phase 3, zoldonrasib + pembrolizumab + chimiothérapie à base de platine en 1L NSCLC métastatique non-épidermoïde RAS G12D, 430 patients, ouvert le 2026-08-14
RASolve 307 — Phase 3, elironrasib (RMC-6291) en 1L NSCLC RAS G12C, initiation prévue T4 2026.
Le site clinicaltrials de Revolution Medicines liste également RMC-5127 (G12V-sélectif) en Phase 1/1b (NCT07349537)

Deux candidats allèle-sélectifs supplémentaires sont en développement préclinique : RMC-0708 (sélectif Q61H, picomolaire, non-covalent) et RMC-8839 (sélectif G13C, picomolaire, covalent), tous deux décrits comme soumis à la priorisation du portefeuille.

Deux candidats allèle-sélectifs supplémentaires sont en développement préclinique : RMC-0708 (sélectif Q61H, picomolaire, non-covalent) et RMC-8839 (sélectif G13C, picomolaire, covalent), tous deux décrits comme soumis à la priorisation du portefeuille.

Le 10-Q du 2026-06-30 (déposé le 2026-08-05) de Revolution Medicines, Inc. décrit une nouvelle classe chimique de tri-complex RAS(ON) inhibitors conçue pour surmonter la résistance médicamenteuse induite par RAS, avec un essai first-in-human prévu au T4 2026.

Under the regional rights agreement, Revolution Medicines has granted BeOne exclusive rights in select Asian markets to develop and commercialize or solely commercialize, depending on the market, these four clinical-stage RAS(ON) inhibitors.

In February 2026, we entered into a clinical collaboration with Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS) pursuant to which BMS plans to evaluate its compound navlimetostat, an MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor, in combination with daraxonrasib in patients with PDAC as part of a BMS-sponsored trial.

In February 2025, we entered into a clinical collaboration with Amgen Inc. (Amgen) pursuant to which Amgen is evaluating its compound AMG 193, an MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor, in combination with daraxonrasib in patients with 2L PDAC as part of an Amgen-sponsored trial.

In June 2025, we entered into a clinical collaboration with Summit Therapeutics, Inc. (Summit) pursuant to which we are evaluating the safety and efficacy, in multiple solid tumor settings, of our clinical-stage RAS(ON) Inhibitors, including daraxonrasib, elironrasib and zoldonrasib, in combination with Summit’s ivonescimab, a PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody.

In May 2025, we entered into a collaboration with Iambic Therapeutics (Iambic), pursuant to which Iambic uses its artificial intelligence capabilities to generate customized models through training with our proprietary data.

fiches.marche_vise: MTAP-depleted, RAS mutant PDAC or lung cancer
fiches.extrait: In November 2024, we entered into a clinical collaboration with Tango Therapeutics, Inc. (Tango) pursuant to which Tango is evaluating its compound vopimetostat (TNG462), an MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor, in combination with daraxonrasib or zoldonrasib in patients with MTAP-depleted, RAS mutant PDAC or lung cancer as part of a Tango-sponsored trial.
In November 2024, we entered into a collaboration with Break Through Cancer.
